      "amount": "20000",
      "description": "Offered through University of Auckland International College (UP Education). Eligibility: top Foundation students progressing to a University of Auckland bachelor's degree. More information: https://www.auckland.ac.nz/assets/study/scholarships-and-funding/find-a-scholarship-or-award/regulations/university-of-auckland-foundation-pathway-high-achiever-award.pdf"

      "name": "International Student Excellence Scholarship",
      "type": "Percentage",
      "studyLevel": "Postgraduate",
      "eligibility": "Applicant must: (a) be an international student; (b) have received a conditional or unconditional offer of admission to an eligible master's programme at the University of Auckland; and (c) have an Admissions GPE of at least 7.0.",
      "amount": "25",
      "description": "A tuition fees credit of up to 25% of the recipient's tuition fees for the first two semesters of their master's degree. Eligibility: applicant must be an international student. Eligibility: applicant must have received a conditional or unconditional offer of admission to an eligible master's programme at the University of Auckland. Eligibility: applicant must have an Admissions GPE of at least 7.0. More information: https://www.auckland.ac.nz/assets/study/scholarships-and-funding/find-a-scholarship-or-award/regulations/university-of-auckland-international-student-excellence-scholarship.pdf"
    },

      "name": "University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship",
      "type": "Amount",
      "studyLevel": "Postgraduate Research",
      "eligibility": "Applicant must be a domestic student, or an international student who is eligible to pay domestic fees for the doctoral programme. Applicant must not already hold a doctorate, must not have previously received payment for a University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship, and must not be enrolled in a doctoral programme (with limited exceptions for masters transfers, doctoral transfers and bridging programme entrants).",
      "amount": "34468",
      "description": "Supports excellent domestic and international doctoral candidates whose research aligns with the strategic objectives of the University of Auckland. Applicable programmes: PhD, DMedSc, DClinPsy, DocFA, EdD and DHSc. Term: up to 42 months of full-time equivalent enrolment. Application: no separate application is required. Applicants indicate in their doctoral application that they wish to be considered. Selection: based on alignment with the strategic objectives of the University and the relevant faculty or research institute. Eligibility: applicant must be a domestic student, or an international student who is eligible to pay domestic fees for the doctoral programme. Eligibility: applicant must not already hold a doctorate or have previously received payment for a University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship. Eligibility: applicant must not be enrolled in a doctoral programme, except for approved transfers. More information: https://www.auckland.ac.nz/assets/study/scholarships-and-funding/find-a-scholarship-or-award/regulations/university-of-auckland-doctoral-scholarship.pdf"
